# What is this vet associate offer actually worth, next to the other one?

> Free veterinarian associate pay calculator. Compare two offers, salary, percentage of production or base plus percentage above a threshold, at the production you expect: yearly value, real percentage after exclusions, hourly rate and where the offers cross. Runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
